slides.title: What Counts as an Evidence Gap
bullets: A relevant clinical question current evidence doesn't answer well
Matters to practice, patients, payers, or regulators
Systematic identification is one of an MSL's most strategic contributions
It links field work directly to future research planning

slides.title: Population and Comparative Gaps
bullets: Population gaps: pivotals exclude elderly, comorbid, renal or hepatic patients
Also pregnant patients and underrepresented ethnic groups
Comparative gaps: trials often used placebo or an outdated comparator
Leaves how it compares to today's standard of care unanswered

slides.title: Outcome and Implementation Gaps
bullets: Outcome gaps: missing long-term, quality-of-life, or patient-reported data
Also missing economic and healthcare-burden impact data
Implementation gaps: unclear how to apply treatment optimally in practice
Beyond simply whether it works under ideal conditions

slides.title: Three Sources, Combined
bullets: A systematic or scoping literature review maps what's already answered
Clinical guidelines often flag areas of consensus-based uncertainty
MSL field insights frequently surface gaps before literature does

slides.title: From Gap to Study Takes Evaluation
bullets: A gap doesn't automatically justify a new study
Assess clinical relevance: how many patients, how much impact
Assess methodological feasibility and strategic alignment
A joint call by Medical Affairs, HEOR, and evidence teams

slides.title: Structured Beats Anecdotal
bullets: Documenting gaps structurally raises the odds they become real studies
Anecdotal mentions are far easier to lose in the pipeline
The MSL's field perspective validates or nuances a gap's true relevance

takeaway.title: Evidence gaps are relevant unanswered questions, and MSLs who document them systematically help turn them into real studies
bullets: Gaps arise from population, comparator, outcome, or implementation limits
Literature review, guidelines, and field insight together surface them
Relevance, feasibility, and strategy fit decide which gaps get studied
